articles.title: Watch: Smoke over Riyadh airport after Houthi's major attack on Saudi Arabia
articles.summary: On Saturday, Houthi rebels executed a large-scale offensive against Saudi Arabia, causing tremors in the capital, Riyadh, where explosions reverberated. Flight operations at the nearby airport faced delays as Saudi air defenses successfully intercepted a ballistic missile aimed at the city.

articles.summary: The Indian shooting team kicked off their Asian Games journey by clinching a silver medal, thanks to the impressive efforts of Elavenil Valarivan, Sonam Maskar, and Vidarsa Vinod. Both Elavenil and Sonam made it to the final of the individual 10m air rifle competition.

articles.summary: Rose-Hulman students have developed a remarkable wearable device tailored for visually impaired individuals. This innovative headgear employs advanced sensors to identify surrounding obstacles, providing users with haptic feedback.

articles.title: 'It's a Medical Miracle' BO day 2
articles.summary: Sangeeth Prathap and Sharafudheen's 'It's a Medical Miracle' earned Rs 43 lakhs net in India on Day 2, marking a 21.8% drop from its opening collection. The Malayalam movie has now collected Rs 98 lakhs net and Rs 1.15 cr gross.

articles.title: Vijay Sethupathi clarifies leadership remark being linked with Vijay
articles.summary: Vijay Sethupathi has clarified that his previous comments regarding leadership on Bigg Boss were exclusively directed at the contestants. He emphasized that these statements did not pertain to any external individuals or organizations.

articles.title: 'Ride Or Die' Season 2: Prime Video cancels action-comedy; studio shops series to other buyers
articles.summary: The action-comedy series 'Ride or Die' has officially been axed after its debut season, leaving fans in suspense. Despite impressive viewership and favorable feedback from audiences, the studio is exploring alternative options for the show.

articles.title: Ajith Kumar's 'Gladiators' trailer takes fans inside his racing world
articles.summary: The documentary trailer for Ajith Kumar titled 'Gladiators' has just been unveiled, providing a glimpse into his fervent love for motorsport and the inherent dangers involved. Featuring heartfelt contributions from his wife Shalini and their children, it sheds light on his thrilling racing career.
